name: Bishoku
source: Kenji Asama has returned to his home city to exact revenge on Douzan Kanzaki, his hated father. And all the girls somehow involved with Douzan will become the instrument of Kenji's revenge, willing or not...
translation: 浅间贤治回到家乡，向他憎恨的父亲神崎道山报仇。而所有与豆赞有牵连的女孩，无论愿不愿意，都将成为健二复仇的工具……
